findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_rule_review_queue, get_rule_citations · Private data: find_elected_lagna, prepare_consultation_intake, record_prashna_outcome, record_consultation_outcome · Public sink: validate_rule_spec, audit_prediction_claim · Destructive: prepare_consultation_intake, run_longitudinal_validation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_rule_review_queue, get_rule_citations · Private data: find_elected_lagna, prepare_consultation_intake, record_prashna_outcome, record_consultation_outcome · Public sink: validate_rule_spec, audit_prediction_claim · Destructive: prepare_consultation_intake, run_longitudinal_validation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
